author: Shri Raghavendra Swami
commentary: वा हन्ति । घातयाम्येनमिति वा हन्म्येनमिति वा भावं न करोतीत्यर्थः
translation: He who knows this (person) to be incapable of being lost or destroyed, to be unborn and unmodified, --how can he, such a person, think of himself as killing or causing another to kill or to be killed.(21)
